why_it_matters: Single-number summary of India risk across all six drivers. Designed for read-at-a-glance — the higher the number, the more drivers are concurrently elevated. Methodology page explains weights and bands.
formula: Correlation-adjusted weighted avg of 6 drivers · weights w=[oil:3, freight:2, flows:3, macro:3, real_econ:2, sector_breadth:2] (normalized to 20%/13.3%/20%/20%/13.3%/13.3%) · adjustment subtracts pairwise w_i·w_j·ρ_ij·(v_i-50)·(v_j-50)/Σw² when both drivers elevated (ρ from literature: oil↔macro 0.55, oil↔flows 0.40, oil↔freight 0.50, macro↔flows 0.45, macro↔real_econ 0.35, flows↔breadth 0.45) · clipped 0-100.
methodology_notes: v2 changes vs v1: (1) status-bucket avg replaced with z-score against sparkline_12m, (2) missing-data penalty returns null when >30% feeders stale, (3) correlation-adjusted top-level avg, (4) triple-jeopardy flag when oil+macro+flows all >=65, (5) regime_score (EWMA) + shock_indicator (point-move >=8 vs 30d baseline) split, (6) manual override layer via data/manual-overrides/india_risk_score.json.
notes: Bands locked: Low 0–35, Med 35–65, High 65–85, Shock 85+. Recalculated on every driver update.
